creators.name: Agrawal, Priyank
creators.affiliation: Independent Researcher, New York, NY, United States

metadata.description: Research records for 4,320 expanded backend-generation outcomes (4,319 source files and one incomplete/no-source response), 38,880 current measurements, and separately identified historical 320-program/common-guard evidence. Includes exact prompts, raw provider/measurement provenance, trusted scientific code and saved-record reproduction. The original S2 archive is unchanged; a separate reporting-additions asset contains historical probe-inventory verification and a retrospective hypothetical four-task sensitivity calculation. All unsuccessful outcomes and repeat flags remain retained. Formal expanded inference is qualified post-review; repeated measures are not independent extra programs. Research data follow scoped CC BY 4.0 terms, while software/documentation retains MIT and third-party/provider rights remain unchanged.
